units.meaning: Introduces the subject matter heading for subsection (3) regarding marketing authorization requirements, without establishing an independent legal obligation.

Notwithstanding any other provision of the subpart (except the transition provisions in § 164.532), a covered entity is mandated to obtain an authorization for any use or disclosure of protected health information for marketing purposes, unless an enumerated exception applies.
